content:
A historical amendment replaces the complete allocation map, preserving the original conversion's cash leg and principal. Replacement allocations must sum to that principal, belong to the account, cover the original submission minute, remain unexpired at amendment execution and have enough unreserved capacity.

The operation restores the old allocations and consumes the replacement amounts, charging the published amendment fee. It does not issue another conversion or refund the original cash.
